name: GENETEC
recent: Genetec 于2026年11月6日与 Citaglobal Berhad 及 Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd 签署股份出售协议，以1令吉出售其在 Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd 的50%股权，并转让约224万令吉的应收款。公司于11月17日公布截至2026年9月30日季度的业绩，并于11月18日召开第28届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。此外，董事在10月于公开市场增持股份。
notable: 以1令吉出售 Citaglobal Genetec BESS 的50%股权，并转让约224万令吉的应收款。
第28届常年股东大会所有决议获股东通过，包括董事费、董事连任、审计师续聘、股份发行授权及股票回购授权更新。
董事 Allen Lik-Hook Ting 和 Sow Ewe Lee 在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 公司以1令吉出售亏损的合资企业股权并转让应收款，交易本身不带来现金流入。
最近一个财年（2026年6月30日止）净亏损1602万令吉，净亏损率为71.9%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为2227万令吉，环比增长8.8%，但同比下跌50.3%；净亏损为1602万令吉，净亏损率71.9%，较上一季度的87.7%有所收窄。

recent_en: On 6 November 2026, Genetec entered into a share sale agreement with Citaglobal Berhad and Citaglobal New Energy Sdn Bhd to dispose of its 50% stake in Citaglobal Genetec BESS Sdn Bhd for RM1 and transfer a receivable of approximately RM2.24 million. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 17 November and held its 28th AGM on 18 November, where all resolutions were passed. Directors also acquired shares in the open market in October.
notable_en: Disposed of 50% stake in Citaglobal Genetec BESS for RM1 and transferred a receivable of approximately RM2.24 million.
Directors Allen Lik-Hook Ting and Sow Ewe Lee acquired shares in the open market.
risks_en: The company disposed of a loss-making JV stake for RM1 and transferred a receivable, with no cash inflow from the transaction itself.
The most recent financial year ended 30 June 2026 recorded a net loss of RM16.02 million, with a net loss margin of 71.9%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM22.27 million, up 8.8% QoQ but down 50.3% YoY; net loss was RM16.02 million with a net loss margin of 71.9%, narrowing from 87.7% in the previous quarter.
